name: kg-alerts
title: 知识图谱实验：用药安全预警（三元组建图 + 多跳查询 + 本体校验）

assertions.name: 图的规模与类型统计正确
图更新都落到图上（新增/撤销/更正/最终规模）
assertions.expr: out.crud.added_edges === expected.crud.added_edges && out.crud.added_nodes === expected.crud.added_nodes && out.crud.removed_edges === expected.crud.removed_edges && out.crud.updated_edges === expected.crud.updated_edges && out.crud.final_n_nodes === expected.crud.final_n_nodes && out.crud.final_n_edges === expected.crud.final_n_edges

assertions.name: 本体校验真的生效（违反本体的更新被拒绝）
每一条预警都带完整推理路径（≥3 个三元组）
assertions.expr: ['contraindication','interaction'].every((k) => Array.isArray(out.alerts_before[k]) && out.alerts_before[k].every((a) => Array.isArray(a.path) && a.path.length >= 3 && a.path.every((t) => Array.isArray(t) && t.length === 3)))

assertions.name: 更新前的禁忌证预警与口径一致（含路径）
assertions.expr: JSON.stringify(out.alerts_before.contraindication.map((a) => [a.patient, a.drug, a.with, a.path])) === JSON.stringify(expected.alerts_before.contraindication.map((a) => [a.patient, a.drug, a.with, a.path]))

assertions.name: 更新前的相互作用预警与口径一致（含路径）
assertions.expr: JSON.stringify(out.alerts_before.interaction.map((a) => [a.patient, a.drug, a.drug2, a.path])) === JSON.stringify(expected.alerts_before.interaction.map((a) => [a.patient, a.drug, a.drug2, a.path]))

assertions.name: 更新后的禁忌证预警与口径一致（撤销医嘱要反映出来）
assertions.expr: JSON.stringify(out.alerts_after.contraindication.map((a) => [a.patient, a.drug, a.with, a.path])) === JSON.stringify(expected.alerts_after.contraindication.map((a) => [a.patient, a.drug, a.with, a.path]))

assertions.name: 更新后的相互作用预警与口径一致（补录要反映出来）
assertions.expr: JSON.stringify(out.alerts_after.interaction.map((a) => [a.patient, a.drug, a.drug2, a.path])) === JSON.stringify(expected.alerts_after.interaction.map((a) => [a.patient, a.drug, a.drug2, a.path]))

assertions.name: 图与说明齐全（至少 1 张，含一句话结论）
assertions.expr: Array.isArray(out.figures) && out.figures.length >= 1 && out.figures.every((f) => f && typeof f.path === 'string' && f.path.trim() !== '' && typeof f.takeaway === 'string' && f.takeaway.trim().length >= 10)

assertions.name: 说清可解释性与局限（notes ≥ 40 字）
